acceptanceCriteria: Impact on a mapper-resolved Ruby path emits no native-Go profile-gap line; an unmapped .rb path still does
A CLI test pins both cases
body: PR #1137 (V1-1794, NGI-V0-036) removes reverse-import-rule-unavailable for mapped Ruby paths, but reverseImportProfileGap (keyed on the suffix-only ImpactRuleNamed, GPK-V0-027) still adds 'reverse-import results for 1 changed paths with no named resolution rule are outside the native Go impact profile'. Evidence: real CLI on testdata/ruby-autoload-1130 in /private/tmp/cem10-build/gh-rbimpact1794. Expected: a mapped path gets no profile-gap line (fix also adjusts the CLI budget fallback).
title: impact: a Ruby path the autoload mapper resolves still reports 'outside the native Go impact profile' (residual of PR #1137)
